turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: God, if anyone can build an app in a weekend now, what's actually becoming valuable?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Not the app. The people waiting for it.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Wait, the app isn't the valuable part?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Over half a million new apps hit the App Store in just six months this year. That's almost as many as all of last year, but downloads only went up 2%.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: So everybody's building and nobody's downloading?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Picture two taco trucks. Same tacos. One has a line of people down the street. Anyone can make tacos now. The line is the valuable part.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question
a person speaking in a flat deadpan monotone

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Okay, but how do I get a line? I have like nine followers.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: You don't need millions. You need a few hundred people with the same problem. Step one, pick one kind of person and one problem you know well, like parents with picky eaters.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: How do I find out what they need?
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Step two, in the Claude app, ask me to find what parents of picky eaters complain about most online. I search and hand you their top 10 problems in their own words.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Then I build the app.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: That's the mistake everybody makes. They build for months, then launch to nobody. Step three, post one free tip for them every day. I can turn each problem into a short video script.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Why give it away for free?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Free help is how strangers start to trust you. Trust is what builds the line at your taco truck. Step four, get them on an email list. Kit is free for your first 10,000 people.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Why email? I already have followers.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Followers are rented. Instagram can change its rules any day. Your email list is yours. Kit gives you a free sign up page. Put its link in your Instagram bio.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Okay, now do I build the app?
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Almost. Here's the tip most people skip. Sell it before you build it.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Sell an app that doesn't even exist yet?
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Ask me for one screen of it. Email a screenshot to your list. Sell early access in Kit for $5. They pay now and get it first. If 10 people pay, we build the rest this weekend. If nobody pays, you just saved a month.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: So the app is the easy part now?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: Anyone can make the tacos. Not everyone has the line.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 1
turns.text: Okay, one free tip every day. I'm starting next Monday.
earshot_tone: a confused person asking a question
a confused person asking a question

turns.speaker: SPEAKER 2
turns.text: You said that last Monday. Ask me anything.
